text.base:
You turn back toward the weather.

EARTH ACCESS GRANTED.
Return may include love, weather, taxation, bodies, music,
forgetting, dogs, and unresolved questions.

The desk stamps nothing, because you never filed anything
it could stamp. It seems to respect this.
Go be somebody. Again.

labels: FICTION: the return door, which was always in the room
nodes.a11y: You choose to return to Earth. The Bard grants access and wishes you a life.
nodes.fallback: You go back. The desk does not mind.

text.base:
You walk toward it.

It does not congratulate you. It does not need to.
The paperwork, such as it was, remains on the desk —
incomplete, and, it turns out, always optional.

Go gently. Mind the brightness.

labels: FICTION: the light door, which was always in the room
nodes.a11y: You choose to walk into the light. The Bard lets you go without ceremony.
nodes.fallback: You walk into the light. The form was always optional.
